>
[Warden’s Reload](/Feats.aspx?ID=4906) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 163

**Frequency**
once per round

**Requirements**
Your last action or activity this turn was to cast a warden spell

</column>

---

Your mastery of magic and weapons like the crossbow allow you to wield both with equal ease. Interact to reload a weapon you are currently wielding.
